display.title: Episode 224: Rabbi Akiva, Saved by Negel Vasser (Sefiras HaOmer)
display.summary_short: A Sefirah-time show with no music: why we hold back from celebrations, how washing negel vasser saved Rabbi Akiva in prison, and why loving every Jew is a great rule of the Torah.
display.summary_long: Recorded during Sefiras HaOmer, this show opens without the usual music. Uncle Yossi explains that there is a time to be happy and a time to be sad: during Sefirah we avoid celebrations, new clothes and haircuts in memory of Rabbi Akiva's students, who did not show each other respect and died in a plague that ended on Lag BaOmer. We must check that we honor one another, which brings Ahavas Yisroel, unity and Moshiach. A boy from Staten Island says the Shema in Studio 604. Uncle Yossi then talks about water, Hashem's precious gift that also has the power to make us pure, which is why we wash negel vasser every morning. In the story, Rabbi Akiva is jailed for teaching Torah; after three days without water he uses his small jug to wash his hands and make a brachah, and the amazed ruler frees him and makes him an advisor. Uncle Yossi explains Rabbi Akiva's teaching that loving your fellow as yourself is a great rule of the Torah, and a lesson from Pirkei Avos: Hashem chose humble Har Sinai. The show ends with a sponsor and a contest update.
display.lesson: Show respect and love to every Jew, and treasure the mitzvos even when it is hard, as Rabbi Akiva did.

date.note: Consistent with the audio ('Pesach, the one we just celebrated'; contest closed Yud-Gimmel Nissan). Most of the show is a rebroadcast of episode 122 (Sefirah 5744).
